FILM SUITE

FROM SET TO FINAL FRAME

Anamorphic lenses and cinema cameras — desqueeze, capture, and grade on your MacBook.

High-end anamorphic footage fits Anamorphic Desqueezer. High-end bodies feed CineLut Live Grade over SDI or HDMI with a video capture card — record straight to the MacBook, skip costly in-camera cards, and lean on your Mac’s CPU and GPU for heavy work instead of the camera’s internal processor.

Broad compatibility with the major camera brands and workflows you already run on set.

  • Live desqueeze preview
  • Real-time LUT + scopes
  • Clean, export-ready output

FAQ

Do I need an NLE?

No. Use the suite for monitoring, capture, and live looks. Editorial can stay in the tools they already use.

Does it support common anamorphic ratios?

Yes—common squeeze factors and custom math for unusual lenses.

How do exports hand off to editorial?

The apps are designed around clean export paths, preserving geometry and look intent for the next stage.

Is this optimized for mobile and tablets?

Yes—responsive layout, performance-first media, and reduced-motion support.
